translation: Greatly cold, non-toxic. It mainly removes latent heat in the stomach, seasonal qi and warm heat, heat diarrhea and dysentery, removes small worms in the intestines, boosts the qi of the liver and gallbladder, and stops fright and agitation. It grows in Qiju and Wanqu. Gather the root in the second, eighth, eleventh and twelfth months and dry in the shade.
